title: Repeated Substring Pattern
description: Given a non-empty lowercase string `s`, determine whether `s` can be constructed by taking a non-empty proper substring of `s` and concatenating two or more copies of it together. Return `true` if such a repeating pattern exists, otherwise `false`.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: If s is a repetition of a smaller block, what happens when you concatenate s with itself?
Check whether s appears inside (s + s) after trimming the first and last characters.

examples.explanation: No proper substring can be repeated to form "aba".
The substring "abc" repeated four times forms "abcabcabcabc".
